tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the authenticated account. Account summary plus the earn-side rollup (credits earned today / last 7 days), active FeelingSurfViewer session count, and site-slot usage.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update account settings. Update non-sensitive account settings (e.g. `visit_own_sites`, `timezone`). Writable account settings. Provide at least one. Email, password and billing are intentionally not editable via the API.

tools.name: list_surf_sessions
tools.description: List your FeelingSurfViewer sessions. Recent FeelingSurfViewer sessions on your account (the earning side), most recent first. These are your own FeelingSurfViewer instances and their IPs.

tools.name: get_referrals
tools.description: Get your referral program. Your shareable referral link, how many users you've referred, your commission rate, and commission credits earned.

tools.name: get_traffic_availability
tools.description: Traffic availability by country. Surfer-traffic availability per country, to guide a site's or template's location targeting. A country with `availability: none` has no surfers delivering visits, so targeting it yields nothing. A fixed reference dataset (~250 countries), returned in full — not pagin

tools.description: List your sites.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Get one site.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create a site. Only `url` is required; every other field defaults to a new-site configuration. Exceeding the account's slot count returns 403 `site_limit_reached`. tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Update a site. Writable fields of a site. For PATCH, provide at least one; only the fields present are changed.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Delete a site.

tools.name: list_deleted_sites
tools.description: List sites you can still restore. Sites you deleted within the retention window, most recently deleted first. Sites removed because a plan downgrade reduced your slot count are not listed: those come back on their own when you upgrade again.

tools.name: restore_site
tools.description: Restore a deleted site. Brings back a site you deleted, with the settings it had. Geo targeting, blocked domains and actions your plan cannot use stay suspended and come back empty. Returns 404 once the retention window has passed, and 403 `site_limit_reached` when you have no free slot.

tools.name: list_site_screenshots
tools.description: List a site's FeelingSurfViewer screenshots. Screenshots captured while the app surfed the site. Returns the most recent (up to 24); this list is not paginated.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Get a screenshot image. Returns the image FeelingSurfViewer captured. The uid is the last path segment of an `images[].url` from list_site_screenshots.

tools.description: List your traffic sources. Your own sources plus the shared/built-in ones, referenced by id from a site's `traffic_sources`.

tools.name: get_traffic_source
tools.description: Get one traffic source. Works for your own sources and for the shared defaults (e.g. id 1, "Direct visits").

tools.description: Create a traffic source. Exceeding the per-account source cap returns 403 `limit_reached`.

tools.description: Update a traffic source. Provide at least one field.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_screenshot · Private data: update_account, update_proxy · Public sink: update_account · Destructive: delete_site, delete_site_template, delete_traffic_source, update_proxy, delete_proxy, delete_label.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_screenshot · Private data: update_account, update_proxy · Public sink: update_account · Destructive: delete_site, delete_site_template, delete_traffic_source, update_proxy, delete_proxy, delete_label

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
